summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on updating connected facility data for Finland. Key updates included implementing a new `connected_facilities_factor` and re-linking `connected_facilities` values for two specific facilities using updated values (highlighted in purple). All connected facilities, including the newly linked ones, must have session data available starting from December 1, 2022.

Later, [me] reported making changes to make device IDs on non-sensor screens unique relative to original 'connected' identifiers. This was done because the initial implementation resulted in only about 5% of unique devices, while the rest remained unchanged. The goal was to return the uniqueness levels closer to pre-'no-sensor facility' metrics.

Finally, [p1] noted that local debugging (without cleanup or inserts) showed zero impressions for some locations, even those with sensors, though this calculation was only for one day.
decisions: The connected facilities data needs to be recalculated starting from December 2022.
The recalculation should proceed from the ML stage to the staging environment.
action_items: Investigate why local debugging shows zero impressions for certain locations, even those with sensors.
